title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Strawberry Watermelon Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Strawberry Watermelon Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit blends two juicy fruit favourites into one fresh, summery vape. Sweet Strawberry brings soft berry notes with a ripe, summery sweetness, while fresh Watermelon adds gentle flavour and a delicate, thirst-quenching finish. Together, they deliver a light yet flavourful all-day vape with mellow tropical character. Each pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and designed exclusively for use with the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods click into place magnetically and work with the twistable dual pod system for quick flavour switching. With two pods per pack, Strawberry Watermelon offers a soft and fruity pairing that complements mint, citrus, or ice profiles.
